limitations_and_boundaries: The study used only one cancer cell line (A549) and CAFs from three lung adenocarcinoma patients; generalizability to other cancer types or stages is limited.
The in vitro collagen invasion assay may not fully recapitulate the in vivo tumor microenvironment.
The sample size of CAF clones per case is small (5-7 clones), limiting statistical power.
The study did not identify the specific biochemical factors responsible for invasion in Case 3.
The correlation analysis does not establish causation between remodeling areas and cancer cell invasion.

research_questions.statement: How do CAFs with various matrix-remodeling capacities influence cancer cell invasion?

provenance.text_excerpt: These findings showed two types of fibroblast-dependent cancer cell invasion that are dependent on and independent of the remodeling areas generated by CAFs.

claims.statement: There are two types of fibroblast-dependent cancer cell invasion: one dependent on and one independent of the remodeling areas generated by CAFs.

provenance.text_excerpt: The number of invaded cancer cells was moderately and strongly correlated with the remodeling areas generated by each CAF clone originating from Cases 1 and 2 (R2 value = 0.53 and 0.68, respectively), suggesting that the remodeling areas in the ECM may determine the number of invaded cancer cells.

claims.statement: In Cases 1 and 2, the number of invaded cancer cells is positively correlated with the remodeling areas generated by CAF clones, suggesting that the extent of ECM remodeling determines cancer cell invasion.

provenance.text_excerpt: the number of invaded cancer cells was not correlated with the remodeling areas generated by CAF clones originating from Case 3, suggesting that factors other than the remodeling areas might determine the number of invading cancer cells.

claims.statement: In Case 3, cancer cell invasion is not correlated with the remodeling areas generated by CAF clones, suggesting that factors other than the extent of remodeling determine invasion.

experiments_or_tasks: Co-culture A549 lung adenocarcinoma cells with each CAF clone in a collagen invasion assay.
Establish single-cell-derived CAF clones from three primary cultures of lung adenocarcinoma patients (Case 1: 5 clones, Case 2: 5 clones, Case 3: 7 clones).
Evaluate correlations between invaded cancer cell numbers and remodeling areas for each case.
Measure the number of invaded cancer cells and the remodeling areas generated by CAF clones.

methods.name: Collagen invasion assay
methods.protocol_description: 0.3% type I collagen gel coated on 96-well plates. Cells plated at 5×10^4 cells/well (co-culture of CAFs and cancer cells; 2.5×10^4 cells each). After 1 h incubation, wound made with 96-well WoundMaker, cells embedded in type I collagen gel. Fresh medium added. Time-lapse fluorescence and phase-contrast images obtained at 3-h intervals for 48 h. Each data element measured in at least eight fields (magnification ×10) in two or more independent experiments.

methods.name: Image analysis
methods.protocol_description: CL-Quant software used. Algorithms: (1) cell region detected using first frame of phase-contrast images; (2) invasion region determined by subtracting cell region from whole image region; (3) invaded CAF region detected using all time frames of phase-contrast images; (4) remodeling area determined by overlaying invaded CAF region on previous frame of remodeling area for all time frames; (5) number of cancer cells in invasion region counted using red fluorescence images for all time frames; (6) invasion index for CAFs = average of remodeling area / invasion region; (7) invasion index for cancer cells = average ×1000 of number of invaded cancer cells / invasion region.

methods.name: Establishment of single-cell-derived clones
methods.protocol_description: CAFs expressing hTERT-Venus sorted one by one into 384-well plates using FACSAria II. Fluorescence images obtained every 12 h using IncuCyte. When fluorescent intensity increased, retrograde confirmation of single cell presence. Clones expanded sequentially to 96-well, 24-well, 12-well, 6-well plates and 6- or 10-cm dishes.
